name: When should a real estate agent consider implementing Generative Engine Optimization?

mainEntity.name: When should a real estate agent consider implementing Generative Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A real estate agent should consider implementing Generative Engine Optimization when they want to stay ahead of evolving digital marketing trends, particularly the rise of AI-driven search and content generation. If current lead generation methods are plateauing, or if there's a need to enhance online authority and differentiate from competitors, GEO can be beneficial. It's especially useful for agents looking to efficiently scale their content production while maintaining high quality and relevance, ensuring their presence in both traditional search results and AI-generated summaries.
acceptedAnswer.description: Agents should consider GEO to stay competitive, enhance online authority, and scale content efficiently, especially with the rise of AI in search.
